attacks.attack: A1a keep the record in the statistics (log tombstoned)
attacks.reason: delete: claimed head field 'stats' is not the one the certificate determines

attacks.attack: A1b keep the record in the log (no position tombstoned)
attacks.reason: delete: positions empty or repeated

attacks.attack: A1c claim deletion with the log unchanged
attacks.reason: absence: whole-log values do not rebuild the post-deletion root

attacks.attack: A2a tombstone a different record's position
attacks.reason: delete: position does not open to the claimed old value

attacks.attack: A2b present a different record's bytes for the key
attacks.reason: delete: record bytes do not hash to the requested key

attacks.attack: A2c tombstone the right leaf, subtract a different record
attacks.reason: delete: claimed head field 'stats' is not the one the certificate determines

attacks.attack: A3a release the model trained on d after its deletion
attacks.reason: release: (lam I + A) N != delta B

attacks.attack: A3b serve the pre-deletion model after deletion (C20)
attacks.reason: serve: no active model (a deletion invalidated it; awaiting a release certificate)

attacks.attack: A3c re-train on d silently inside a later insert
attacks.reason: insert: claimed head field 'stats' is not the one the certificate determines

attacks.attack: A4 duplicate deleted once (C18 falsifier 1)
attacks.reason: absence: Count(key) = 1 != 0 after deletion

attacks.attack: A5a subtract with a changed feature map (C18 falsifier 2)
attacks.reason: delete: claimed head field 'stats' is not the one the certificate determines

attacks.attack: A5b a head under a different genesis (phi, lam)
attacks.reason: new head does not extend the ledger head

attacks.attack: A6a genesis with lam = 0 (C18 falsifier 3, singular system)
attacks.reason: Genesis refuses lam <= 0

attacks.attack: A6b a second encoding of the same model (non-canonical)
attacks.reason: release: (N, delta) not in canonical form

attacks.attack: A7 replay the deletion against the next head (stale parent)
attacks.reason: parent is not the ledger head (stale or forked)

attacks.attack: A8a drop one leaf from the whole-log opening
attacks.reason: absence: whole-log values do not rebuild the post-deletion root

attacks.attack: A8b substitute one leaf in the whole-log opening
attacks.reason: absence: whole-log values do not rebuild the post-deletion root

attacks.attack: A9 a second child of the same parent (fork)
attacks.reason: parent is not the ledger head (stale or forked)

attacks.attack: A10 delete a record that was never inserted
attacks.reason: delete: position does not open to the claimed old value

attacks.attack: A11 release with an extra row carrying the deleted record (Codex r1)
attacks.reason: release: N is not a D x 10 integer matrix

attacks.attack: A13 a head with an extra field carrying the deleted record (Codex r2)
attacks.reason: delete: claimed head has fields other than the ledger's (Codex round 2)

attacks.attack: A12 a record with a trailing payload element
attacks.reason: delete: record is not a 64-feature optdigits record with a label
